name: Azathioprine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Blocks azathioprine inactivation; higher 6-mercaptopurine levels and toxicity (label).
key_interactions.action: Reduce azathioprine to about one-third to one-quarter of the usual dose; reduce further or change therapy if TPMT activity is low.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Co-trimoxazole and other drugs affecting white-cell production
key_interactions.effect: Exaggerated leukopenia, especially in kidney transplant recipients (label).

key_interactions.action: Avoid if possible; monitor blood counts closely.
Use with caution; monitor blood counts.
